snippet.title: Metro Exodus Enhanced - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the trailer for Metro Exodus Enhanced for an in-depth breakdown of the features for the PC Enhanced version as well as a look at Metro Exodus Complete Edition, the next-gen console update of the game.

Metro Exodus PC Enhanced Edition, the update which features ray tracing and more, is available now. 

Additionally, the Metro Exodus Complete Edition--a physical Gen 9 version of Metro Exodus, including all Expansions, will launch alongside the free upgrade for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 on June 18, 2021.

#IGN #Gaming
